variablesInModel.Name: composition choice
variablesInModel.Description: 1 if composition c in C_t is chosen for trip t, 0 otherwise; c = 0 is the empty composition (trip canceled). Binary by (19).

variablesInModel.Name: composition transition
variablesInModel.Description: 1 if trip t has composition c and its successor trip v(t) has composition c', for (c,c') in Gamma_t; 0 otherwise. Binary by (20).

variablesInModel.Name: coupled units
variablesInModel.Description: Number of units of type m coupled to the composition right before trip t. Declared in R+ by (16), hence continuous although it counts units.

variablesInModel.Name: uncoupled units
variablesInModel.Description: Number of units of type m uncoupled from the composition right after trip t. Declared in R+ by (16), hence continuous although it counts units.

variablesInModel.Name: inventory after departure
variablesInModel.Description: Units of type m in inventory at station s_d(t) right after trip t departs; R+ by (16). Own family (indexed by trip), separate from the station inventories I_{m,0}^s, I_{m,end}^s, I_{m,off}^s.

variablesInModel.Name: initial inventory
variablesInModel.Description: Initial inventory of unit type m at station s; R+ by (17). A decision variable in the paper, fixed to the planned value i_{m,0}^s by (14).

variablesInModel.Name: ending inventory
variablesInModel.Description: Inventory of unit type m at station s at the end of the day; R+ by (17).

variablesInModel.Name: changed-composition indicator
variablesInModel.Description: 1 if trip t is executed with a composition other than the planned composition p_0^t, 0 otherwise. Binary by (21).

variablesInModel.Name: additional coupled units
variablesInModel.Description: Number of additional coupled units right before trip t (one symbol nc, split as n c_t in the MathML); R+ by (18).

variablesInModel.Name: additional uncoupled units
variablesInModel.Description: Number of additional uncoupled units right after trip t (one symbol nu, split as n u_t in the MathML); R+ by (18).

variablesInModel.Name: ending-inventory off-balance
variablesInModel.Description: Off-balance of the ending inventory of unit type m at station s against the planned ending inventory i_{m,end}^s (absolute value via (12)-(13)); R+ by (17).

objective_functions.Name: (1) weighted rescheduling cost
objective_functions.equation: \min \sum_{t,c \in C_t} w_1 \mathrm{carr}_c l_t x_c^t+\sum_{t,c \in C_t} w_2 \mathrm{seat}_c^t h_t x_c^t+\sum_t w_3 x_0^t+\sum_{s,m} w_4 I_{m,\text{off}}^s+\sum_t w_5 \mathit{nc}_t+\sum_t w_6 \mathit{nu}_t+\sum_t w_7 p_{\text{diff}}^t
objective_functions.description: Weighted carriage-km, seat-shortage hours, cancellations (x_0^t = empty composition c=0, family x), inventory off-balances, additional (un)coupled units, changed compositions; carr, seat, l, h, w_1..w_7 are parameters.

constraints.Name: (2) one composition per trip
constraints.description: Exactly one composition, possibly the empty one (c = 0, cancellation), is chosen for each trip.

constraints.Name: (3) transition link to the successor trip
constraints.equation: x_c^t = \sum_{c' \in C_{v(t)}: (c,c') \in \Gamma_t} z_{c,c'}^t \quad \forall t \in T \setminus T_1, c \in C_t
constraints.description: Composition c is chosen for trip t if and only if an allowed composition change (c, c') to the successor trip v(t) is chosen.

constraints.Name: (4) transition link from the predecessor trip
constraints.equation: x_{c'}^{v(t)} = \sum_{c \in C_t: (c,c') \in \Gamma_t} z_{c,c'}^t \quad \forall t \in T \setminus T_1, c' \in C_{v(t)}
constraints.description: Same link on the successor side; x_{c'}^{v(t)} is the composition variable of trip v(t), i.e. family x.

constraints.Name: (5) coupled units of a transition
constraints.equation: c_m^{v(t)} = \sum_{(c,c') \in \Gamma_t} \beta_{c,c'}^m z_{c,c'}^t \quad \forall t \in T \setminus T_1, m \in M
constraints.description: Units of type m coupled before the successor trip v(t) follow from the chosen transition; beta is a parameter and c_m^{v(t)} belongs to family c_m^t.

constraints.Name: (6) uncoupled units of a transition
constraints.equation: u_m^t = \sum_{(c,c') \in \Gamma_t} \alpha_{c,c'}^m z_{c,c'}^t \quad \forall t \in T \setminus T_1, m \in M
constraints.description: Units of type m uncoupled after trip t follow from the chosen transition; alpha is a parameter.

constraints.Name: (7) inventory after each departure
constraints.equation: I_m^t = I_{m,0}^{s_d(t)} - \sum_{t' \in T: s_d(t')=s_d(t), \tau_d(t') \le \tau_d(t)} c_m^{t'} + \sum_{t' \in T: s_a(t')=s_d(t), \tau_a(t') \le \tau_d(t)-\rho(s_d(t))} u_m^{t'} \quad \forall t, m
constraints.description: Inventory at s_d(t) after trip t departs: initial inventory there (family I_{m,0}^s) minus earlier couplings plus earlier uncouplings. The fraction under each sum is its index condition, not a division.

constraints.Name: (8) ending inventory
constraints.equation: I_{m,\text{end}}^s = I_{m,0}^s - \sum_{t \in T: s_d(t)=s} c_m^t + \sum_{t \in T: s_a(t)=s} u_m^t \quad \forall s \in S, m \in M
constraints.description: Ending inventory per unit type and station: initial inventory minus all units coupled plus all units uncoupled at that station.

constraints.Name: (9) changed-composition indicator
constraints.equation: p_{\text{diff}}^t \ge \sum_{c \in C: c \neq p_0^t} x_c^t \quad \forall t \in T
constraints.description: p_diff^t is 1 if trip t gets a composition other than the planned one; p_0^t is a parameter (the planned composition).

constraints.Name: (10) additional coupled units
constraints.description: Additional coupled units before trip t. oc_t (oc^t in the text, 'o c_t' in the MathML) is the parameter 'original coupled units', not o times c; variables: nc and c_m^t only.

constraints.Name: (11) additional uncoupled units
constraints.description: Additional uncoupled units after trip t. ou_t (ou^t in the text) is the parameter 'original uncoupled units', not o times u; variables: nu and u_m^t only.

constraints.Name: (12) off-balance, surplus side
constraints.equation: I_{m,\text{off}}^s \ge I_{m,\text{end}}^s - i_{m,\text{end}}^s \quad \forall s \in S, m \in M
constraints.description: With (13), I_off is at least the absolute difference between actual and planned ending inventory; lower-case i_{m,end}^s is the planned value (parameter).

constraints.Name: (13) off-balance, shortage side
constraints.equation: I_{m,\text{off}}^s \ge i_{m,\text{end}}^s - I_{m,\text{end}}^s \quad \forall s \in S, m \in M
constraints.description: Second half of the linearized absolute value of the ending-inventory off-balance; i_{m,end}^s is a parameter.

constraints.Name: (14) initial inventory as planned
constraints.equation: I_{m,0}^s = i_{m,0}^s \quad \forall s \in S, m \in M
constraints.description: Initial inventories equal the planned ones (parameter i_{m,0}^s). Kept as a constraint: a fixing the paper numbers among its constraints, while (16)-(21) are the domain declarations.

constraints.Name: (15) fixed compositions before the disruption
constraints.description: Trips departing before the disruption keep their planned composition p_0^t. Kept as a constraint (a fixing on a subset of trips), not a domain declaration.
